about_the_game:
This DLC is meant for the most hardcore community members that want to go above and beyond the regular, in support of Call to Arms - Gates of Hell.

The Supporter Pack offers a chance to stand out in our community as a loyal supporter, with special accents to your profile in the game as an outstanding contributor.

For our small team, the support of our loyal fans has been invaluable throughout the years. Many of you have been supportive right from the start, and have stuck with us throughout the development cycle. After the release of the original “Ostfront” we went on to release almost 60 free game updates, all of them contributing to the experience it offers today. While our team remains small, we’re thrilled to keep working on the game, made possible thanks to our growing playerbase.

This optional Supporter Pack is for those who want to go the extra mile for Call to Arms – Gates of Hell.

While the base game already offers the full experience and continues to receive updates, this edition is a way for passionate players to help us push the franchise even further. Your support directly helps us invest in long-term improvements—like upgrading the engine, overcoming technical hurdles, and bringing long-requested features to life.

You don’t need to buy this to enjoy the game—but if you choose to, you’re helping shape its future. And for that, we’re incredibly grateful.

At the same time, this DLC allows our most generous supporters to stand out and be recognised for their incredible contribution.

The Supporter Pack does not bring any game content, to ensure that there is no paywall on any of it.

Instead, as a thank you, we decided to put a free DLC together that offers a ride down memory lane, with something new on the side. It is the Jubilee DLC, to celebrate the 10 years we’ve been working on the game. Go check out and download the free content!

The Supporter Pack contains some behind the scenes content which will allow the players to connect with the history behind the project, the trials and tribulations we encountered over the years, and some cool visuals and additions to make your experience more wholesome.

Supporter Pack items:

  • A customised appearance of the player’s profile, with a unique color and avatar ribbon.

  • “Supporter Pack” badging in the game interface

  • The official Call to Arms - Gates of Hell art guide.

  • “Gates of Hell: The first decade”, a 15 minute documentary detailing our story, with the personal testament of some of the team members involved. It outlines the origins of the project and the people that made it into what it is today: one of the most played ww2 themed RTT/ RTS worldwide. From the project’s conception in 2015 to release in 2021 and beyond!

  • An exclusive windows theme with cursors, backgrounds, artwork and images of the game to make your whole desktop experience be tuned in the art of the game.

For those community members that would like to go the extra mile to support Call to Arms - Gates of Hell, we have created this DLC. We would like to invest the revenue in taking key steps to improve the game’s engine architecture further, keep the game future-proof and overcome some of the obstacles that have kept some highly requested improvements at bay. While we always strive to improve the game with the means made available to us, we appreciate every help we can get!

Thank you for 10 years of your support, on to the next 10 years!

content_descriptors.notes: Contains historically accurate depictions of WWII battles.

name: Call to Arms - Gates of Hell: Supporter Pack
short_description: Only for our most hardcore fans: Support us above and beyond the call to arms! Stand out as a special supporter, with accents to your in-game profile as an outstanding contributor. You also receive the official artbook, windows theme and a behind the scenes documentary about the making of the game.
